reason: A DeepSeek Harness client plugin that visualizes agent status, tool activity, approvals, progress, and outcomes in a floating Dynamic Island-style overlay; the README identifies it as a high-fidelity prototype with real-GUI integration work remaining.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以可拖动的动态岛浮层展示智能体状态、工具活动、审批、进度和任务结果。
summaries.en: A draggable Dynamic Island-style overlay for DeepSeek Harness that displays agent status, tool activity, approvals, progress, and task results.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek Harness session and agent state
Displays streaming output, tool activity, approvals, progress, errors, and completion receipts
Provides UI actions for approval, retry, unblock, and continue states
Persists the draggable overlay position across reloads
